scope: Primary sources for replacing a bare three-handle count by a certified boundary-surgery movie, a standard four-dimensional cap, and an explicit cap-extension theorem.

references.title: A Calculus for Framed Links in S3

locators.label: framed-link surgery calculus
locators.locator: Theorem 1 and the two generating operations at the beginning of the article, journal pages 35-37

references.formalized_scope: Two integral framed links in S3 present orientation-preservingly diffeomorphic surgery 3-manifolds exactly when they are connected by framed isotopy, handle slides, and addition or removal of an isolated plus-or-minus-one framed unknot.
references.critical_caveat: The movie whitelist must include stabilization and destabilization. Handle slides alone would invoke the unresolved Generalized Property R problem.

references.title: A note on 4-dimensional handlebodies
references.journal: Bulletin de la Societe Mathematique de France
references.formalized_scope: Every orientation-preserving diffeomorphism of the boundary of a four-dimensional 1-handlebody extends over the 1-handlebody.
references.use_in_this_project: The upside-down 1-handlebody is the standard cap consisting of g three-handles and one four-handle. Extension makes the closed completion independent of the chosen boundary standardization.

references.title: On diffeomorphisms of 4-dimensional 1-handlebodies
references.formalized_scope: Theorem 2.5 states that every diffeomorphism of the boundary of a four-dimensional 1-handlebody extends to a diffeomorphism of the handlebody.
references.interpretation_limit: This theorem gives cap-choice independence. It does not create a boundary standardization certificate for an arbitrary lower-handle diagram.

explicit_non_claims: A homology calculation alone does not certify that a boundary is a connected sum of S1 times S2.
A bare natural number h3 does not specify three-handle attaching spheres.
A boundary Kirby movie does not by itself provide d3 unless sphere systems and their transport are also implemented.
No concrete boundary certificate for a repository Kirby presentation is asserted by this reference ledger.
